title: Florida House, District 39
what_it_does: Represents District 39 in the Florida House of Representatives; votes on state laws and the state budget.
decided_note: Incumbent Republican Doug Bankson won the Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary over Carlos F. Johary Sr. and faces Democrat Jarod Fox on Nov. 3.
verified_ballot_note: Search-result summaries of Seminole County 2026 election coverage (Oviedo Community News; Ballotpedia's Seminole County 2026 page) state incumbent Republican Doug Bankson will face Democrat Jarod Fox in November after defeating Carlos F. Johary Sr. in the Republican primary (https://oviedocommunitynews.org/2026/06/17/whos-on-the-seminole-county-primary-ballot-for-2026/; https://ballotpedia.org/Seminole_County,_Florida,_elections,_2026). Research limitation: every WebFetch (Ballotpedia, Wikipedia, Division of Elections, county SOEs, news sites) was blocked and the search budget was capped, so this roster comes only from search-result snippets and should be re-verified against the county Supervisor of Elections sample ballot.

candidates.name: Doug Bankson
candidates.background: Incumbent Republican state representative for HD 39 (Apopka area; parts of Orange and Seminole counties), first elected 2022. Won the Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary over Carlos F. Johary Sr.
candidates.primary_result: Won Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary over Carlos F. Johary Sr.
